Phobos.Framework.Upgrades.PhobosBuilding.label: receive preamplifier
Phobos.Framework.Upgrades.PhobosBuilding.description: A small low-noise amplifier between the antenna lead and the radio, switched out of the way whenever the station sends. It makes the station's receiver about 3 dB quieter, so it hears faint hand-helds better where the colony is quiet. It does nothing against a nearby generator: that noise arrives with the signal.

Phobos.Framework.Upgrades.PhobosBuilding.label: second transceiver
Phobos.Framework.Upgrades.PhobosBuilding.description: A second radio set beside the first, on its own channel, so the desk can serve twice as many colonists at once: up to ten instead of five, taking turns.

Phobos.Framework.Upgrades.PhobosBuilding.label: taller pole
Phobos.Framework.Upgrades.PhobosBuilding.description: A longer steel pole that lifts the whip from three metres to five, over most walls, so only walls close to a hand-held still get in the way.

Phobos.Framework.Upgrades.PhobosBuilding.label: mast extension
Phobos.Framework.Upgrades.PhobosBuilding.description: Another lattice section and a second set of guy wires, raising the mast from ten metres to fifteen, so the line to a hand-held clears walls for even longer.

Phobos.Framework.Upgrades.PhobosBuilding.label: longer collinear
Phobos.Framework.Upgrades.PhobosBuilding.description: A longer stacked antenna for the top of the mast. It squeezes more of the signal towards the horizon, for about 6 dB of gain instead of 3: signals both ways come in about twice as strong.

Phobos.Framework.Upgrades.PhobosBuilding.label: aviation transceiver
Phobos.Framework.Upgrades.PhobosBuilding.description: A second set in the station for the aircraft bands: the civil air band and military UHF, by AM voice. With aviation antennas on a mast on its coax, the station can talk to aircraft. Its own built-in whip cannot work these bands.

Phobos.Framework.Upgrades.PhobosBuilding.label: aviation antennas
Phobos.Framework.Upgrades.PhobosBuilding.description: Two more antennas bolted to the mast, one for the civil air band and one for military UHF. A station with an aviation transceiver on this mast's coax can talk to aircraft through them.

Phobos.Framework.Upgrades.PhobosBuilding.label: marine transceiver
Phobos.Framework.Upgrades.PhobosBuilding.description: A second set in the station for the marine band, by FM voice. With a marine antenna on a mast on its coax, the station can talk to boats. Its own built-in whip cannot work this band.

Phobos.Framework.Upgrades.PhobosBuilding.label: marine antenna
Phobos.Framework.Upgrades.PhobosBuilding.description: Another antenna bolted to the mast, for the marine band. A station with a marine transceiver on this mast's coax can talk to boats through it.
